name: LOLIN C3 Mini
notes: LOLIN (WEMOS) C3 Mini v2.1.0: 34.3 x 25.4 mm bare ESP32-C3FH4 (4 MB flash), USB-C, ceramic antenna, D1 mini footprint.

Older v1.0.0 boards differ: the left column runs EN, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 3V3, the LED is a plain blue one, and the PCB antenna has notoriously weak Wi-Fi (cap TX power, e.g. WiFi.setTxPower(WIFI_POWER_8_5dBm)).
Native USB Serial/JTAG only (GPIO18/19, not broken out); GPIO9 (BOOT button) is not broken out either. Arduino defaults: TX=21, RX=20, SDA=8, SCL=10, SPI SCK=2 / MISO=3 / MOSI=4 / SS=5.

7.label: LED
7.note: Onboard LED: WS2812B data-in on v2.1.0 (drive with the NeoPixel protocol), plain blue active-HIGH LED on v1.0.0.

8.label: SDA
8.note: Strapping pin with a 10 k onboard pullup - do not pull LOW at boot.
